title: Manufacturing Engineering Technician I - Third Shift - Bryan Dairy

cond_0001.intro:
Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0339.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, providing equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines. This role involves regular, hands-on interaction with operators, engineers, supervisors, and other technicians throughout the shift.
cond_0339.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and actively assist as needed to accomplish repairs.
Work closely with Machine Operators on assigned line(s), providing ongoing training and direction on a daily basis. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Stay in regular contact with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and serve as the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality — speaking up early when issues arise and initiating discussions to resolve them.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Work directly with Manufacturing Engineers to achieve optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and/or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift, clearly walking them through line status and any outstanding issues. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

cond_0360.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, supporting equipment and processes across printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0360.responsibilities:
Working closely with operators, engineers, and supervisors, you will help maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. You will coordinate with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. You will observe machine and line performance and work with others to determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. You will help monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
You will maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and coordinate with the team to determine when out-of-cycle maintenance is needed. You will perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). You will carry out initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within your skill level. For more complex issues, you will escalate to Industrial Techs and assist them as needed to accomplish repairs.
You will support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction, and assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. You will work alongside Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, helping to ensure that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to other Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. You will assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling, and contribute to product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0360.requirements:
Associate's degree highly preferred

cond_0450.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, supporting equipment and processes across printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0450.responsibilities:
Working closely with operators, engineers, and supervisors, you will help maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups. You will coordinate with the team to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. You will observe machine and line performance and work with others to determine the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. You will help monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance.
You will maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and coordinate with the team to determine when out-of-cycle maintenance is needed. You will perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). You will carry out initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within your skill level. For more complex issues, you will escalate to Industrial Techs and assist them as needed to accomplish repairs.
You will support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction, and assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. You will work alongside Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, helping to ensure that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
You will provide training to other Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. You will assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. You will share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling, and contribute to product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. You will provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

Provide equipment and process support (including machine maintenance) to printed circuit assembly lines.
Must have manufacturing knowledge or experience with SMT processes for PCBA box builds, wave soldering, selective soldering and experience with PMs and troubleshooting of soldering equipment.
cond_0480.responsibilities:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files and machine set-ups. Optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate. Observe machine and line performance and determine the necessary steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality. Monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data (and other available sources of information) continuously for tracking and gauging machine and process performance. Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Determine when necessary machine repairs are needed and perform out-of-cycle maintenance. Perform 'as-required' preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s). Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s), and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs, and provide assistance as needed to accomplish repairs. Assist Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation in order to expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency. Interface with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers and Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, and be the front line person in ensuring that assigned line(s) performs with the maximum efficiency and product quality. Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees. Assist Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and / or optimizing of reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste. Provide recommendations for designing, fabricating and / or modifying necessary tooling, and product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements. Provide daily 'pass-down' reports to Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift. Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0480.requirements:
Associate's degree preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
Around one to two years of experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering and/or related training — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Around one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
We evaluate candidates holistically and welcome applicants who are still building their skills in these areas.

cond_0603.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineering Technician I to join our team, providing equipment and process support — including machine maintenance — to printed circuit assembly lines.
cond_0603.responsibilities:
Maintain and develop machine programs, part definition (PD) files, and machine set-ups in coordination with the broader engineering team.
Work with Manufacturing Engineers to optimize machine programs and set-ups to meet or exceed theoretical product run-rate.
Observe machine and line performance and coordinate with the team on the steps needed to achieve optimum line efficiency and product quality.
Monitor [Product name masked], [Product name masked], ICT Diagnostic defect analysis sheet, feeder data, and other available sources of information continuously, sharing findings to help track and gauge machine and process performance.
Maintain and repair all SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Identify when machine repairs are needed and carry out out-of-cycle maintenance.
Perform as-required preventative maintenance of SMT equipment on assigned line(s).
Perform initial diagnosis of non-SMT equipment on assigned line(s) and execute repairs within skill level. Escalate more complex issues to Industrial Techs and assist as needed to accomplish repairs.
Support Machine Operators on assigned line(s) by providing ongoing training and direction. Assist with machine operation to help expedite changeover, cover breaks, or otherwise improve line efficiency.
Work closely with Line Supervisors, Manufacturing Engineers, and the Machine Support Manager to determine corrective actions needed, helping to ensure that assigned line(s) performs with maximum efficiency and product quality.
Provide training to Manufacturing Engineering Tech I employees.
Support Manufacturing Engineers in achieving optimum process performance by measuring and/or optimizing reflow profiles, wave solder profiles, and screen printing of solder paste.
Share recommendations for designing, fabricating, and/or modifying necessary tooling, and contribute to product design for manufacturability (DFM) improvements.
Provide daily pass-down reports to the Project Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, and the Manufacturing Engineering Technician on the following shift.
Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.
cond_0603.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum one to two years of related knowledge or experience with SMT process, wave soldering, selective soldering, and/or training
Minimum one to two years of experience with PMs and troubleshooting of SMT and soldering manufacturing equipment on circuit assembly lines
Or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred Requirements
Associate's degree
